prd.title: Hotline Intake Modal
prd.overview: The Hotline Intake Modal converts a phone conversation into a chain-anchored incident in under 90 seconds, while the caller is still on the line. The operator who takes the call is the proxy reporter; the resulting incident always defaults to T1 (unverified, divider neutral) and carries the --color-reporter-hotline hotline reporter-badge. T3 is reserved for consumer-notice issuance only. The modal is mounted on the OperatorDashboard top-chrome via a single Log hotline call button.

scope.views: operator-dashboard action bar trigger; modal mounted over dashboard
scope.platform: Emit IncidentCreated{reporter_kind: hotline_operator, band: T1} OR HotlineCallLogged{outcome: no_incident} via POST /api/events; mint hotline_call_id (UUID v7)

requirement.title: Mount trigger button on OperatorDashboard top-chrome
requirement.description: Add Log hotline call button to OperatorDashboard action bar. Leftmost position (before View Audit Log and Settings). Phone icon (lucide 16px). Button variant: secondary (slate outline).

acceptance.criterion: Button visible on /dashboard for utility_operator
Click opens HotlineIntakeModal with focus trap
Focus restores to trigger button on close

requirement.title: Six-field form in spec order
requirement.description: Render 6 fields in order: caller name (opt), caller phone (opt), call time (default now, editable via DatePicker), incident description (req, 500c), location hint (req), call outcome (req, dropdown with 3 options: incident / inquiry / missed).

acceptance.criterion: Tab order matches: caller name → caller phone → call time → description → location hint → outcome → Cancel → Submit
Description char-counter enforces 500 limit
Required fields marked with asterisk per lockdown 06-data-formats-lockdown.md

requirement.title: Submit gating by required fields
requirement.description: Submit button disabled until description, location hint, and outcome are all filled. Visual disabled state per foundation §10.

acceptance.criterion: Submit disabled when any required field empty
Submit enabled when all 3 required fields filled

requirement.title: Outcome branching: incident vs no-incident
requirement.description: Outcome = 'incident': emit IncidentCreated{reporter_kind: hotline_operator, hotline_call_id, description, location_hint, call_time, band: T1}. Close modal. Toast confirms with incident ID. New incident appears at top of inbox with Phone icon + --color-reporter-hotline chip. Outcome = 'inquiry' OR 'missed': emit HotlineCallLogged{reporter_kind: hotline_operator, hotline_call_id, outcome: no_incident, call_time}. Close modal. Different toast: Call logged. No incident created.

acceptance.criterion: Outcome=incident emits IncidentCreated with band=T1 (not T2/T3) and reporter_kind=hotline_operator
Outcome=inquiry/missed emits HotlineCallLogged, not IncidentCreated
Toast text matches spec exactly per outcome

requirement.title: ESC / Cancel with dirty confirmation
requirement.description: ESC key or Cancel button: if any required field has content, open confirmation dialog (Discard this call log? You can keep editing.). On confirm: discard and close. On keep editing: dismiss dialog. If no dirty fields: close immediately.

acceptance.criterion: ESC with empty description skips confirmation and closes
ESC with filled description opens confirmation dialog
Cancel button behaves identically to ESC

requirement.title: MSW: HotlineCallLogged event handler
requirement.description: Extend web/src/mocks/handlers.ts POST /api/events to accept HotlineCallLogged event type. Persist via idb-keyval. Add hotline_call_id mint helper (UUID v7 pattern).

acceptance.criterion: POST /api/events with type=HotlineCallLogged returns 200 and persists
hotline_call_id is UUID v7 format

requirement.title: Modal primitives from web/src/components/ui/
requirement.description: Use Modal (640px wide, centred, focus trap), Input, DatePicker, Dropdown, Button (primary + ghost), Toast. Per lockdown decision #4.

acceptance.criterion: Modal width is 640px on desktop
Focus traps within modal; restore on close
No upstream shadcn imports

requirement.title: Bangla-first labels for text-heavy fields
requirement.description: All field labels, button text, outcome names translated to BN; Bangla is default on this surface (operator dashboard chrome can be EN). Toggle works; preference persists in IDB.

acceptance.criterion: Field labels render in Bangla on first mount
Toggle persists across reloads

requirement.title: i18n keys added (EN + BN parity)
requirement.description: Add to web/src/i18n/locales/en/operatorDashboard.json and bn/: actions.logHotlineCall, hotline.modal.{title,subtitle,callerName,callerPhone,callTime,description,locationHint,outcome,button.cancel,button.submit,toast.incidentCreated,toast.callLogged,discardConfirm.{title,body,discard,keepEditing}}. Hotline outcome labels: incident / inquiry / missed.

acceptance.criterion: EN and BN key sets match
No Hindi keys present

requirement.title: Reconciliation: pre-lockdown draft if exists
requirement.description: Verify no Hindi strings; replace any band=T3 default; ensure reporter_kind: hotline_operator is the ONLY reporter-kind for hotline events.

acceptance.criterion: grep 'hi' locale returns zero hits in this component
Default band literal is T1 (not T2/T3)
reporter_kind=hotline_operator on both IncidentCreated and HotlineCallLogged

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Mount OperatorDashboard as utility_operator; assert Log hotline call button visible. Click; assert modal opens with focus on first input. Modal opens; focus trapped.
Tab through fields; assert order matches spec. Fill description past 500 chars; assert counter prevents. Tab order correct; 500 char limit enforced.
Mount modal; assert Submit disabled. Fill description only; assert still disabled. Fill all 3 required; assert enabled. Submit gating correct.
Fill form; select outcome=incident; submit; assert IncidentCreated event with band=T1 and reporter_kind=hotline_operator. Reset; select outcome=inquiry; submit; assert HotlineCallLogged (not IncidentCreated). Outcome branching correct.
Open modal; press ESC with empty form; assert closes immediately. Fill description; press ESC; assert confirmation dialog. Click Keep editing; assert stays. Click Discard; assert closes. Dirty confirmation correct.
